# Appendix: R Output {-}

This appendix shows the R output behind the tables and numbers quoted in the main text, in the order they appear. Objects such as `fit`, `BP` and `vif_gap` are created by the code in the code appendix.

## Initial Data Analysis (Section 2.1) {-}

```{r out-ida, echo = TRUE}
c(duplicates = n_dup, missing = n_na, nonpositive = n_nonpos)
cat_stats
round(ida_cor, 3)
```

## Initial Full Model (Section 2.2) {-}

```{r out-full, echo = TRUE}
summary(fit)
```

## Model Diagnostics (Section 2.3) {-}

Constant variance and normality:

```{r out-diag-tests, echo = TRUE}
sd_fitted     # residual SD by fifth of fitted values
sd_category   # residual SD by category
BP            # Breusch-Pagan
BF            # Brown-Forsythe across categories
SW            # Shapiro-Wilk on 5,000 sampled studentized residuals
skew(fit$residuals)
```

High leverage, outliers and influence:

```{r out-diag-unusual, echo = TRUE}
round(c(leverage_cutoff = 2 * p / n, max_leverage = max(h)), 6)
sum(lev)      # number of high-leverage observations
summary(dat[lev, c("price", "competitor_pricing", "category")])
c(bonferroni_cutoff = cut_t, max_abs_rstudent = max(abs(t)))
sum(out)      # number of outliers
dat[out, c("demand", "promotion", "category")]
max(D)        # largest Cook's distance
```

## Addressing Model Inadequacies (Section 2.4) {-}

Multicollinearity:

```{r out-vif, echo = TRUE}
vif(fit)
vif(fit_gap)
cor(dat$price, dat$price_gap)
coef(summary(fit_gap))[c("price", "price_gap"), ]
```

Box-Cox transformation and the square-root model:

```{r out-boxcox, echo = TRUE}
c(lambda_hat = lambda_hat, CI_lower = CI[1], CI_upper = CI[2],
  loglik_drop_at_0.5 = max(loglik) - loglik[lambda == 0.5])
summary(fit_sqrt)
bptest(fit_sqrt)
```

Weighted least squares:

```{r out-wls, echo = TRUE}
niter         # IRLS iterations until convergence
F_ols         # Brown-Forsythe F across category x promotion, square-root OLS
F_wls         # Brown-Forsythe across category x promotion, WLS standardized residuals
summary(fit_wls)
round(cbind(OLS = b_ols[, 1], WLS = b_wls[, 1], SE_ratio = se_ratio), 3)
```
